description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Godagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520017
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration and amendment under the Registration of Title Act, focusing on the expunging of particulars from a land parcel schedule. It contains detailed land identification information including parcel number, block, cadastral map, village, Grama Niladhari Division, Divisional Secretary's Division, district, and province. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement from the Land Title Settlement Department, confirming this is exclusively about land and property matters.
